name: The Number Seven
overview: The number seven in Scripture signifies completeness and divine order, as seen in the completion of creation when God finished the heavens and the earth (Genesis 2:1). It also represents perfection and fullness in God's covenantal instructions, such as the command to take clean animals by sevens for preservation (Genesis 7:2) and the counting of seven sabbaths of years culminating in the year of Jubilee (Leviticus 25:8). Additionally, seven is associated with sacred worship and dedication, exemplified by the seven altars and offerings prepared by Balaam (Numbers 23:1) and the sanctification of the tabernacle and its instruments (Numbers 7:1). This number consistently points to God's sovereign design and purposeful timing in redemptive history.
